findings.title: Two general dual-mode representative JPEGs do not match the new report preview hashes
findings.impact: The latest dual-mode report source hashes and 64 PC cases are valid, but its two representative preview files are stale relative to its preview_sha256. The nine-source heading gallery and all heading preview hashes match and are unaffected.
findings.recommendation: Replace these two JPEGs with the unmodified latest CI artifacts, then independently compare their SHA256. Do not rewrite the report hashes to fit stale files.
